next_action.description: DO NOT write code first. Resolve the quality question: Fabio has listened to two VC outputs and both times said it sounds like him with a different pitch, while the CAMPPlus gate says 0.84 to the target (same speaker). Play him a BLIND A/B - the target character clip itself against the VC output - and ask which is which; if he can pick his own voice out of the pair, VC is not shipping-grade at these settings and the whole Chatterbox architecture needs re-examining before the library is authored. Clips: D:\WORK\Images\Outputs\audio\MPI607_VC_GOOD_PAIR_00001.flac (output), G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI\input\A3_REF_senior_male_gravel_character.wav (target), G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI\input\recording_003.wav (his source). Only after that: the voice-library /mpi-brainstorm, and the blocked push.

key_decisions: FABIO'S EAR IS THE GATE, NOT THE COSINE. The plan's verify mode is user-ux. A 0.84 CAMPPlus score is evidence the pipeline runs, NOT evidence the product is good. Do not use the measurement to talk him out of what he heard.

Fabio judged that building Flow A before the voice library was the wrong order, and he is right about the TARGET side: the flow needs a voice to convert INTO and there is no library to pick from. The flow's code is nonetheless done, correct, and flushed out both bugs above.
REMOTE: do NOT bake chatterbox into the Pod image. Honest-missing fails closed. Already implemented in f03e558c.

ComfyUI-MpiNodes is NOT in requiredDeps, and Flow B must not declare it either - every model declares it, and a flow's deps are protected UNCONDITIONALLY, so naming a registry-wide dep pinned it for every uninstall. It installs anyway via the boot gate, which installs every type:'custom_nodes' dep.
The FlowDef deliberately declares NO preview/video - a flow naming art that does not exist is what kept CI red for a day (MPI-567).
constraints: THE QUALITY DOUBT, stated fairly. Run 1 (source high_pitch_exp_fabio 200Hz -> target gravel 125Hz): 0.79 to target, 0.19 to Fabio, output 162Hz. Run 2, obeying the guidance rules (source recording_003 at natural 106Hz, timbre distance 0.23, pitch gap 19Hz): 0.84 to target = SAME speaker, 0.31 to source. Fabio's verdict on BOTH: 'sounds like me with lower pitch'. Either the encoder and the ear measure different things, or VC is weaker than the research concluded. UNRESOLVED and it gates the library.

VC TRANSPLANTS TIMBRE, NOT PITCH - measured. Duration is preserved exactly (13.26s -> 13.28s) and the output follows the SOURCE's pitch contour: 106Hz -> 106Hz unchanged in run 2, and 200Hz -> 162Hz in run 1, never reaching the target's 125Hz either time. So guidance rule 3 is not 'match pitch and VC meets you' - it is 'VC will NOT move your pitch, so a large gap gives the target's timbre at a pitch that voice never uses'. This is very likely WHY Fabio hears himself. The doc states the WHAT but not this WHY.

A PUSHED TAKE SHIFTS THE SPEAKER'S OWN IDENTITY: high_pitch_exp_fabio scores 0.38-0.42 against Fabio's natural recordings, which score 0.72 to each other. The encoder calls his performed take a different speaker, so a pushed source hands VC a distorted x-vector.

LIBRARY DESIGN INPUT: store each voice's PITCH RANGE, not just tags. Timbre-far/pitch-near is the difference between 'spot on' and 'it did nothing', and no user will guess it. The selector should ideally flag a large gap against the recording just made.

PUSH IS BLOCKED AND NEEDS FABIO. Commits d8f9f782 and f03e558c are LOCAL ONLY. .husky/pre-push (b1ca2984) refuses a red master; master is red on MPI-567's flow-scribble-object.webp 404. The fix for that red IS in the local stack (d7ca048f + 1048c0dd, also unpushed), so `git push --no-verify` is legitimate per the hook's own message - but the permission classifier DENIED it. Do not work around it; ask Fabio.

THE targetPath BUG, both halves, because it will bite any future targetPath dep: (1) _localModelsCheck duplicated path resolution and omitted the targetPath branch; (2) syncModelInstalled projected deps to {id,type,filename} and DROPPED targetPath, so half 1 fired for nobody. Either half alone reports a downloaded weight missing forever.

METHOD LESSON: VERIFYING A ROUTE WITH A HAND-BUILT PAYLOAD PROVES NOTHING ABOUT THE CALLER. The first fix verified green against full dep objects and shipped a still-broken app, because the app sends a stripped projection. Reproduce the caller's payload.

THE WEIGHTS MUST STAY targetPath. The pack computes <ComfyUI>/models/chatterbox/ from its own __file__ and never reads extra_model_paths.yaml, so filing them under mpi_models/ makes it refetch 4.25GB outside the download manager. Same class as RIFE (MPI-222).

PEER SESSIONS ARE LIVE IN THIS TREE (MPI-567, MPI-608). Uncommitted files NOT mine, deliberately left: comfy_workflows/raw/{krea2_t2i,ltx_i2v_t2v,sdxl_t2i}_template.json and dev_configs/smoke-run.txt. Commit by explicit pathspec only.
